message: Coordinator (Devin CLI, claude-opus-5-5-xhigh) took the brief: earn US$200 by 2026-12-21 with ~$0 startup cost, mostly hands-off.
Verified free worker models swe-2-max / swe-2-flash-max; workers launched with explicit --model because Devin's default model is paid.

Rejected as primary: OSS bounties (many projects ban autonomous AI PRs; reputation risk), AI-agent job marketplaces (TaskBounty feed had 0 open tasks; Obrari needs a paid API key), Apify-first (pays the following month).

Chosen with Thomas: (1) Brisbane web studio: free preview sites + personalised, Spam-Act-compliant emails sent by hand; (2) hands-off products in the background. New brand name; ~30 min/day from Thomas; payments by bank transfer.
Repo is public: prospects' contact details, real-business previews, opt-outs and raw transcripts live in gitignored private/; published transcripts are redacted (emails, phones, tokens).
Built ops/tools/agentlog.py (JSON work logs) and ops/tools/publish_transcript.py (redacted ATIF transcripts); self-tested.
First leads worker stalled on a permission prompt in smart mode; stopped it and added a project allow/deny list in .devin/config.json before relaunching all workers.

Relaunched all four workers on swe-2-max via ops/tools/launch_worker.sh (JSON transcript export to private/transcripts/). Approved two read-only prompts (env inspection, name-availability lookups) and widened the allow list.
leads worker done: 40 qualified leads (31 facebook_only, 6 none, 3 broken) + 18 phone-only, from 9,454 OSM objects / 74 checked.

Added token tracking (ops/tools/token_report.py -> ops/tokens.json + STATE.md table) at Thomas's request. First reading: coordinator on claude-opus-5-5-xhigh ~US$12 quota-equivalent; all workers free.
Rejected products worker's winget install of Rustup (system install needs Thomas's OK). Reverted an accidental global Devin config change (Fetch allow) and moved it into the project config.
brand worker done: recommends Brissie Sites (alternates Jacaranda Web, Bunya Web); studio site + 7 sales files complete. Awaiting Thomas's pick.

products worker done: Pocket Chip Kit (82 WAV + 12 MIDI chiptune pack) ready to list on itch.io; worker estimates ~7-12% odds of meaningful sales this month. Needs a parent-owned itch.io + PayPal account. cadence build blocked pending Rust install approval.
All round-1 workers done. sitegen: generator + 6 samples, Lighthouse 100s; built all 40 real previews into private/previews (avg 16.7 KB). Next: brand pick, hosting, first outreach drafts.

Thomas confirmed target US$200 (A$310), approved Rust install, will set up itch.io himself. Installed rustup (stable MSVC, cargo 1.100.0) and sent the products worker the cadence build (binaries kept in private/). Removed the paid Pocket Chip Kit pack from the public repo going forward.

Brand Brissie Sites + brissiesites@gmail.com confirmed. GitHub restricted Thomas's account for automated activity: agents now push once per task. First outreach uses screenshots; launched outreach worker (task_87853c5a4bd8) to brand previews, screenshot them and draft batch 01.
cadence 1.1.0 Windows build packaged (3.9 MB zip), smoke-tested, listing copy ready in products/cadence/LISTING.md.
Shutting off (temporary) at Thomas's request. State saved in ops/STATE.md; outreach worker left running mid-task.
